input.summary:
Room 18 (owner upper bedrooms) furnished in parts/room-18.mjs: 3 whole beds with the head to a solid wall, a barrel dresser with a standing lantern under the east windows, a fence-and-top-slab table with a lantern by the balcony doors, a stair chair, and a lit candle in the pocket. make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with no refused writes or off-palette blocks.
The bed plan moved: the south bed at (88,7,13..14) walled off the balcony doorway, so it is now at foot (90,7,13), head (90,14); the fourth bed is dropped. Logged in plan.md Notes.
The walk and fit checks are not yet OK, because the shell floor, walls and stair flight belong to other parts that are still stubs.
left: Walk verdict not yet OK: the room check reports 0 of 6 floor cells reachable because the shell floor (y6), walls and the owner flight (x86 z14->10) are not built yet. Re-run `$MCD room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "owner upper bedrooms"` once shell-b and the stairs part land, and confirm the lane x88 z10..14, the balcony doorway (86..87 z14) and the landing (86,7,10) connect.

FIT: three beds report 'against an opening' (heads at x 91 z10/z12 against x 92, and head (90,14) against z 15). These clear once the shell walls are built; the east windows sit at z 11 and z 13 only, so the bed heads should land on solid wall.
Floating-block check: barrels, beds, lanterns and the table slab float until the y6 floor and the flight's rail exist (`mcd check` lists them); none should remain once the shell is in.
Fourth bed from the spec was dropped: the plan's south bed at (88,7,13..14) walled off the balcony doorway, so the room has 3 beds (E z10, E z12, S at z13..14).
Not rendered: the shell is still a stub, so room.png would show only the furniture. Render and look once the shell lands.

waste.what: Worked out each furniture and bed cell, the lane and the light distances by hand, and drew each y-level layer as text.
waste.cost: about 25 coordinate decisions, 3 layers() draws and 2 build-verify cycles
waste.tool: A `mcd room --propose` (or plan --furnish) that takes a furniture list and reports walkability and light on the plan grid even before the shell exists, using a provisional floor and walls from rooms.json.

waste.what: Found by hand that the plan's south bed (88,7,13..14) walls off the balcony doorway; had to reason through the lane and the rail.
waste.cost: one full re-layout after reading the rail and bed geometry
waste.tool: A walk check that also runs on a bare floor plus the declared stair cells (the rail and the flight's footprint are known from plan.md), so such conflicts show before the furniture is drawn.

waste.what: Checked the bed-head and lantern-support rules (head on solid wall, standing lantern on a top slab or barrel) by reading the fit messages rather than a single pre-build check.
waste.tool: `mcd fit --propose` on a furniture text file, so the bed and support rules are verified before the full build.

companions.task: Confirm the flight's landing (86,7,10) and headroom at x 86 z 10..12, and the rail at x 87 z 11..12, so the lane and the table and chair positions can be checked against them.
Confirm the east windows at x 92 z 11 and z 13 (y 8..9) and the front pair at x 90..91 y 8..9 are open cells, so nothing is placed in front of them.
Choose the dresser's form: barrels under the east windows, or a proper chest run, once the wall and window positions are final.
Check the light at the feet once the shell is up, and decide whether a hanging lantern from the ceiling (if the roof leaves y 11 solid) would replace the standing ones.
